description: Public Utility Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. No 20 of 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended), granting a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements. This constitutes a regulatory action and the exercise of statutory powers, making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
